result.title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
result.summary: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

AI.brief_summary: Loupe 是一个面向知识密集型视频生成的 agent，先检索并核验文本与视觉证据，再构建含参考图的时间化提示；作者提出 Rubric-Based Credit（RBC），用提示特定的事实、视觉与时间要求为中间搜索与规划步骤打分，并据此做步骤级重加权的 SFT 与 GRPO，训练时无需渲染视频，同时构建了 Search-VBench。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用任务特定标准给中间步骤分配信用、并据此监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 中间状态的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但对象是外部检索与提示构建而非模型内部推理状态，迁移性需进一步判断。
